# Diagnostics: Diff lock sensor and ABS/VDC lights

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Inspect the differential breather nipple, then extend the tube upward into the tail light area. [t294]

[Partial] Scan for codes, locate the diff lock position switch on top of the rear differential. [t354]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. [Partial] Inspect the differential breather nipple for missing or short components.
2. Extend the breather tube upward into the tail light area to prevent water ingress.

_Procedure reported by [t294]._

<details><summary>Alternate procedure [t354] [Partial]</summary>

1. Scan the vehicle to check for codes related to slip, ABS, and VDC.
2. [Partial] Locate the diff lock position switch connector on top of the rear differential.

</details>
